mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND workout_id = #{workoutId}
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date = #{date} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN actual_calories ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_calories, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PLANNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS planned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN date END) AS active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PLANNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS planned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN actual_calories ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_calories FROM workouts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workouts (user_id, workout_id, date, total_calories, status, estimated_calories, actual_calories, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{workoutId}, #{date}, #{totalCalories}, #{status}, #{estimatedCalories}, #{actualCalories}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), workout_id = VALUES(workout_id), date = VALUES(date), total_calories = VALUES(total_calories), status = VALUES(status), estimated_calories = VALUES(estimated_calories), actual_calories = VALUES(actual_calories), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE workouts SET user_id = #{userId}, workout_id = #{workoutId}, date = #{date}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, status = #{status}, estimated_calories = #{estimatedCalories}, actual_calories = #{actualCalories}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE workouts SET status = #{status}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, estimated_calories = #{estimatedCalories}, actual_calories = #{actualCalories}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
